intro.title: Rite of Discovery — Intro
intro.p1: A family tradition. A quiet choice. Tonight it begins.
intro.p2: Pay attention to details — they might guide your choices.

hallway.title: The Dim Hallway
hallway.body: A heavy metal door blocks your path. A keypad glows faintly.

keypad.title: Keypad Lock
keypad.body: Enter the 4-digit code found on the old parchment.

wires.title: Maintenance Panel
wires.body: Exposed wires hum with power. Connect them correctly to restore light.

chamber.title: The Inner Chamber
chamber.body: The air is still here. You've passed the first trial.

s1.title: Night Before
s1.body: The living room is quiet. Wrapping paper and tags are scattered on the table. One tag has torn apart — reassemble it.
s1.prompt: Assemble the magic tags in the correct order:
s1.hint: Think about the order they were placed on gifts: star first, then heart, then bell.
s1.solved: The handwriting matches mom's note on the fridge. Interesting...
s1.keepQuiet: Keep this to yourself for now
s1.askParent: Ask a leading question at dinner

s2.title: Tooth Tradition
s2.body: In your bedroom, you find two notes — one from the 'Tooth Fairy' and one from a parent. Compare the letters.
s2.prompt: Match the letters that look the same across both notes:
s2.solved: The same handwriting appears on both notes. A pattern is emerging.

s3.title: Proof Moment
s3.body: You overhear muffled voices from the kitchen. There's a receipt on the counter and a gift bag in the closet. What do you believe?
s3.prompt: The evidence is piling up. How do you feel about what you're discovering?
s3.confrontNow: Confront your parents now — you want the truth
s3.saveLater: Save the discovery for later — you're not in a hurry
s3.gentleNote: Traditions are a way families show love. The magic lives in kindness.

epilogue.title: The Rite of Discovery
epilogue.body: Your parents sit down with you. They smile warmly. "We knew this day would come," they say. "Now you're part of the tradition — the helpers who keep the magic alive for younger ones."
epilogue.proud: You feel proud. You're in on the secret now — a rite of passage.
epilogue.cozy: You feel cozy. The magic didn't disappear — it just changed shape.
epilogue.badge: Helper Badge earned! You're now part of the circle of kindness.

outro.title: Discovery Complete
outro.body: You've completed your Rite of Discovery. Every family tradition is a choice to create wonder. Now you can be a wonder-maker too.
outro.gentleToggle: Toggle Gentle Mode for next run
